error.title: Couldn't load the devices
error.text: The list couldn’t be read because the server didn’t respond. Check your connection and try again; if it keeps happening, ask whoever runs the server.

errors.tooLong: The name can have at most {max} characters.

revoke.title: Revoke the device?
revoke.description: "{name}" will no longer be able to open the library. To use it again you will have to pair it from scratch.
revoke.currentDescription: "{name}" is this device: if you revoke it you will be signed out and will have to pair it again to get back in.

phoneNotice.title: A phone needs a secure address
phoneNotice.text: To connect a phone, the library must be reachable at a secure address. Once you have set it up on the server, the button to add a phone will appear here.

pair.qrLabel: QR code to pair the phone: point the camera at it

steps.1: Open Bookeeper on the other computer and choose "Join".
steps.2: Pick this library or type its address.
steps.3: Type the code above. It works for one device only.

phoneSteps.2: Point it at the QR code and open the link.
phoneSteps.3: If you can't scan it, open the address on the phone and type the code.
